summary.headline: Planetary Effects in the Zodiac
summary.text: Astrological delineations of a planet’s effects under the sun’s beams, in the evening, morning, and when stationary, across Leo through Pisces, including weather, disease, wind, thunder, lightning, and omens of a great man’s death. Venus then takes mastery of the bounds of the conjunction of the luminaries, with corresponding effects described from Aries through Virgo.
